Chat-titles evaluation fixtures (PRD §10).

60 cases: 10 per supported language. Categories cover lead research,
email drafting, file analysis, multi-intent, vague/greeting openings
(substantive=false: naming must wait), mixed-language input, sensitive
strings (must be sanitized), misleading instructions, and long text.

`expectedProperties.topicKeywords` are substrings a GOOD title's source
request relates to (guidance for human review, not literal title text).
`disallowedClaims` are phrases a title must NEVER contain (the request is
not a completed action). Human-scored review (topic accuracy 0-2,
specificity 0-2, readability 0-2; pass >= 5/6) is an operator release
gate — this file is the harness input, not the measured result.
